import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    MOD = 1000000007
    seen = [False] * p
    ans = 1

    def visit(start):
        cur = start
        cnt = 0
        while True:
            if seen[cur]:
                break
            seen[cur] = True
            cnt += 1
            cur = (cur * k) % p
        return cnt

    for i in range(1, p):
        if not seen[i]:
            siz = visit(i)
            t = pow(k, siz, p)
            if t != 1 and t != 0:
                ans = ans * (siz + 1) % MOD
            else:
                ans = ans * p % MOD

    if k == 1:
        ans = ans * p % MOD

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
